text: We didn't kiss on the first date, or the second, or the third, even though I really wanted to. Don't know why he made me wait. Because he's a wimp, a chicken, and a slow guy. She will say later in the video that she's obsessed with him and kissing him is all she can think about. And some comments are like, he's so respectful, that he's so wholesome. Yeah, that does sound beautiful and romantic. But guys, don't have your head in the clouds, stay grounded. Like it goes in the old joke, Armenian Radio was asked, what is the difference between a dick and a life? And Radio answered, life is harder. In real life, if the girl shows you she's ready for a kiss and to move to the next stage, but you chicken out and do nothing, there's a huge chance you are not going to see her again. Think of it this way, if you do not act when you have a green light, you move backwards. Again, women may be saying to you, no, this is so romantic, this is nice, this is a sign you really like her. But experience and empirical data say quite the opposite. If you have a green light and you do not act, a lot of women think he is not confident, he is not experienced, he is not man enough, or he's not that into me. And the funny part is, she will not tell you this directly. She can say, there was no spark, or we didn't vibe. Or she can just disappear and never answer your text again. In reality, you just didn't cash the check when it was written to you. Now, let me be clear about one thing. Be respectful and follow basic social etiquette. Make sure you are both comfortable and enjoy the date. Then, when you start seeing that she is giving you a green light to move forward, you should do it. Start with a playful touch, sit closer, maybe hold her hand. If you see she is comfortable with it, move further and eventually go for a kiss. If it works, great, you move to the next stage. If she dodges the kiss, stay respectful, but maybe tease her a bit. You can say something like, the way you were looking at me, I thought you'd be mad if I didn't kiss you right away. Bottom line, guys, don't be a wimp, because most of the time this gets you nowhere. As a confident man, if you see a green light from a girl, act.
